intro: Painted Gnoll Armbands are crude adornments worn by the Riverpaw gnolls prowling the outskirts of Elwynn Forest. Westbrook Garrison collects these marked bands as physical proof of bounties fulfilled against the encroaching packs.

p: The Riverpaw pack marks its warriors and scavengers with rough armbands painted in crude tribal patterns. The painted bands are collected from the Riverpaw gnolls along the wilderness borders of Elwynn Forest. To the defenders of Stormwind, however, they represent a growing territorial menace encroaching near Stone Cairn Lake and the woods south of Westbrook Garrison.

With the Stormwind Army stretched thin across the kingdom, Westbrook Garrison struggles to keep the western border secure against encroaching threats. Deputy Rainer placed a standing bounty on the invading packs, directing adventurers to slay Riverpaw outrunners and runts. The painted armbands serve as undeniable proof of the kill, allowing garrison deputies to tally bounties and thin the gnoll population encroaching on nearby farmlands.
